clause: Without --system-image or a config override, creation uses system-images;android-35;google_apis;arm64-v8a.
actual: The physical AND-004 creation command had no --system-image and its retained AVD config records image.sysdir.1=system-images/android-35/google_apis/arm64-v8a/, abi.type=arm64-v8a, tag.id=google_apis, and hw.device.name=pixel_8.
